verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator documents user-driven deletion of its cloud backup. It also documents that diagnostic logs stay in the app until the user chooses to send them, which gives some control over retention. Community reports of data wiped on update, password removal, and rooted-device wipes describe vendor-initiated deletion, not a failure of user deletion controls, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, documented deletion of Microsoft-held account or telemetry data, a full account-data deletion or export workflow beyond passwords, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
